decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the retention of a public kiosk to provide combined payphone\ATM machine, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable and complementary to the visual amenity of the locality.  The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and S.4.4 (Access to shopping facilities) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The colour to be used on the external surfaces of the phone kiosk hereby permitted shall be dusty grey matching those in drawing RAL 7037/Pantone 424 received by Council on 15th March 2005.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the phone box/ATM machine shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
description: Conversion of existing double public telephone kiosk to combined ATM and payphone kiosk. (PLEASE NOTE CHANGE OF REF FROM 00248/CN/COM1 tO 00248/CN/P1)
